---
title: "AI rules and guides from publishers"
description: "An overview of what the journals we publish in allow and require."
---

The chemical societies and publishing houses have each written their own AI policies. An overview in one place would help when preparing a manuscript or writing a review.

## Open questions

- What do AAAS, Springer Nature, ACS, Elsevier, RSC, GDCh, and Wiley allow and require?
- How must AI use be disclosed, and where in the manuscript?
- What are the rules for AI-generated or AI-edited figures and images?
- May reviewers use AI tools on manuscripts they review?
